business_summary: Mobile-health Network Solutions, an investment holding company, provides telehealth solutions primarily in Singapore. It operates in two segments: Telemedicine and Other Services and Sale of Medicine and Medical Devices. The company offers MaNaDr platform, a 360-degree healthcare ecosystem, which connects users and service providers through the range of healthcare services and product offerings that can be accessed through the mobile application and website, as well as Internet search engines. It also provides a suite of medical-related and other services, including teleconsultations and health check-up services, vaccinations, skin and aesthetics services, and other services. In addition, the company offers healthcare and wellness products through its online e-commerce platform; wholesale distribution of pharmaceutical products to clinics through MaNaPharma platform; and MaNaCare, a platform that provides a range of corporate healthcare and wellness services, including GP, specialist and allied healthcare panel services, tele-consultation services, in-person clinics, on-site health screening, and online marketplace, as well as wellness programs to corporate customers. Further, it develops IT systems on mobile phone and web portals; operates pharmacies, clinics, and drug stores; and offers beauty and other personal care services, as well as other general medical services. Additionally, the company offers health supplements, skincare, nutrition products and medical devices wellness, personal care; health screening packages; and online services such as medical screenings and procedures, such as serology and swab tests. Mobile-health Network Solutions was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Singapore.
